collection.title: Cupra Leon 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Cupra Leon Hatchback 2020 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Cupra Leon which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: Cupra (SEAT) Leon 2020 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
